test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘HARDWARE’ is coded as 81945195, and ‘INFLUX’ is coded as 956336. How will ‘LEAGUE’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

**Logic: Sum of the digit of alphabet place value.**

‘HARDWARE’ is coded as 81945195

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23dab047074b404dac7f77779c9a9e25505d74f89117d297d60fc728e237e49f.png] 

And,

‘INFLUX’ is coded as 956336

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28114c5b273b92af93aa50d8cd1fb0bf96af84ba84a38d87e3712176737a9def.png] 

Similarly,

‘LEAGUE’ is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5298cd6a42a1acffbaf916a12536486c61a47ce9ad0e7f5c1b18b7bf0299d192.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"351735".**
